title: Setting registry: every config key declares how its default is derived
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. The bundled config has 68 keys. Add a registry naming, per key, its derivation (constant, hardware, detection, measurement, consent) and a test that every key is registered and none is 'user must set'. Tests zc_setting_registry_*.
